sources.entry: ArtificialWatch - AI model release tracker that checks provider APIs every 60 seconds and alerts you by email, push, SMS or phone call when a new model goes live. #freemium

summary.name: ArtificialWatch
summary.one_liner: A paid-and-free alert service that polls AI provider APIs every 60 seconds and notifies you by email, Chrome push, SMS or phone call when a new AI model goes live.
keywords: know when new ai model launches
use_cases: Get alerted the moment a new AI model becomes available on a provider API
Track releases from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and others without checking manually
Trade or forecast 'released by' prediction markets with fast launch confirmation
Hear before a model you rely on is deprecated or retired
Compare a new model against your own prompts (Watchtower tier)
summary.what_it_does: The service sweeps provider APIs and public model catalogs every 60 seconds. A new model must appear on two consecutive sweeps, and where it can be called, reply to a test prompt, before alerts fire. Confirmed launches trigger paid SMS (Signal) or phone call (The Call) alerts immediately, while free Chrome push and email arrive in a batch about 15 minutes later. Users pick which models to follow (SOTA-only, every major-lab LLM, or a custom list) and see a radar, a watchlist of about 193 models, and live Polymarket odds where markets exist. Watchtower adds subscription watch on Claude and Gemini app model lists, price and limit alerts, and scoring of up to 20 user prompts on new models via a blind third-party judge.
notable: Two-sweep debounce and reply test to reduce false alarms
Tiered alerts: free Chrome push/email, Signal SMS at $12/mo, The Call phone call at $19.99/mo
Watchtower tier ($34.99/mo) blind-judges your own prompts on new models
Independent; not affiliated with any AI lab
caveats: Free email and Chrome push arrive about 15 minutes after confirmation; fast alerts require paid tiers
Desktop and mobile apps are only planned; iPhone users get email or paid text/call alerts today
Signal is $12/mo after a 7-day trial and The Call is $19.99/mo with automatic renewal; 18+ only
